info.description: Static JSON API of US federal and state limits, tax brackets and wage rates from ratesandlimits.com; every figure carries the quoted source sentence, its offset in a stored snapshot, the snapshot's SHA-256 and the date it was verified. Knowledge comes from the documentation at https://ratesandlimits.com/api (which lists the five routes) and from live GET probes of every route on 2026-10-23 (55 programs; e.g. `hsa-contribution-limit`, and the state-level `minimum-wage`). Unverified: the shape of a record's `estimate` block (null in every probed record) and of `derived` figures (none observed). State-level programs (`minimum-wage`, `tipped-minimum-wage`) are only reachable through the state route. Responses can be large (`latest.json` ~2.3 MB, `minimum-wage.json` ~3 MB). No key and no rate limit.
